integrity: Analytic infinite-family proof supplemented by two independently structured exact enumerators; independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only equal-rate edge adsorption on finite crown graphs; no generalization to unequal rates or transient dynamics. The sharp error is bounded by a harmonic term, not expanded to second order; historical originality remains provisional.
title: A sharp dimer-jamming defect law on crown graphs
